paper_title: Constraining Ultralight Dark Matter through an Accelerated Resonant Search
notes: 21Ne NMR-mode magnetometer search for axion-nucleon coupling over 4.5-15.5 Hz Compton frequency. Paper reports both neutron (gann) and proton (gapp) couplings; primary/best plot is gann in GeV^-1. Data points are approximate readings from Fig. 3/10 (log-scale spiky curve, averaged limit ~few×1e-9 to 1e-8 GeV^-1). Mass axis: fa in Hz converted via m=4.136e-15*f (e.g. 4.5-15 Hz -> ~1.86e-14 to 6.2e-14 eV). Coupling is in GeV^-1 (non-standard for AxionNeutron which is usually dimensionless); values left as GeV^-1 as printed on axis. Confidence limited by approximate plot digitization and dual coupling reporting. | selector: text (sole candidate)
